product_metadata.title: Shark Rotator Powered Lift-Away XL Capacity (NV755)
features: Upright vacuum cleaner for pet hair and debris: The 3-in-1 design easily transforms into a portable canister with a powered floor nozzle cleaning from floor to ceiling, underneath furniture and other tight spaces.
Clean carpets and bare floors seamlessly by switching between cleaning modes with fingertip controls.
Lightweight and easy to maneuver: Advanced swivel steering allows simple control when cleaning around furniture.
Anti-Allergen Complete Seal Technology with a HEPA filter traps 99.99% of dust and allergens.
Includes Duster Crevice, TruePet Mini Motorized Brush, LED Dust-Away including 1 Pad, Canister Caddy, Dusting Brush, Pet Upholstery Tool, Accessory Bag
description: Shark Rotator powered Lift-Away XL Capacity is a powered Lift-Away providing uninterrupted floor to ceiling cleaning with a large Capacity dust cup. Easily clean under furniture, above the floor, and in all those other hard to reach places around your home. The mini-motorized brush puts all the power of an upright in the palm of your hand. The mini motorized brush picks up pet hair and loose debris, and powerfully deep cleans surfaces LED lights on the wand are perfect for above-floor cleaning- especially for spotting bothersome cobwebs in corners. The floor nozzle also includes led lights, illuminating your work area and making hidden debris easy to find. The fingertip controls on the handle make powering on and off a snap, and they make the transition between hard-floor and carpet cleaning seamless. Armed with advanced swivel steering for excellent control when maneuvering around furniture, the Rotator has Anti-Allergen complete seal technology + HEPA that traps 99.99percent of dust and allergens inside the vacuum. Combined with two foam filters, this dust containment system helps keep dust and allergy-causing agents from escaping back into the air you breathe. This 3-in-1 vacuum instantly transforms into a portable canister with powered floor nozzle for effortless cleaning throughout your home. In addition, the canister caddy can hold all your favorite attachments so they're available at all times. Also included is the new led Dust-Away hard floor attachment, which offers the ultimate hard floor cleaning experience with led lights to illuminate your cleaning area and a microfiber pad to pick up and wipe away fine debris. Based on ASTM F1977 of particles between 0.3 and 0.5 microns
